a-fated-encounter.text: A Fated Encounter movie summary talks about Emma Brown who is forced by her father Henry to take her sister Bella's place and marry Tommy Anderson to save her business. Unlike the rumor Tommy turns out to be a handsome and wealthy man. Soon Emma starts to fall for Tommy despite stating their relationship is just a contract to please their families.
a-fated-encounter.title: A Fated Encounter

a-hamptons-summer-affair-with-my-bff-s-b.text: In A Hamptons Summer Affair with My BFF's Brother movie, Olive Parry agrees to be her BFF Sam’s fake girlfriend, and in return, he would pay for her expenses to save her little brother from his evil foster mom. One condition: don't fall in love with Sam’s older brother. Everything was working perfectly until Olive found out that the man she’d secretly pined for after a one-night stand, and Sam’s off-limit older brother were the same person.
a-hamptons-summer-affair-with-my-bff-s-b.title: A Hamptons Summer Affair with My BFF's Brother

a-sweet-contract-with-the-mafia-boss.text: In A Sweet Contract with the Mafia Boss movie: by chance, Tessa, an emergency room nurse, saved Victor, a dangerous and charming gang boss, but was strongly targeted by him. He was closing in on her, and she was running for her life—until fate tore away her last hope. Her brother was dying, and the sky-high medical bills were crushing her. Victor narrowed his cold eyes and said, "Be my woman, and I'll save him." She was forced to sign a marriage contract. She resisted his world but indulged in his protection and tenderness. When she found out that the mysterious man who saved her on the rainy night five years ago was actually him, the boundary between hate and love completely collapsed...
a-sweet-contract-with-the-mafia-boss.title: A Sweet Contract with the Mafia Boss

accidentally-pregnant-forever-spoiled.text: In Accidentally Pregnant Forever Spoiled movie: since childhood, Ella has lived with her remarried mother and stepfather after her parents divorced. She endured indifference and abuse in her stepfather's household. After her mother passed away, her stepfather and half-brother treated Ella as nothing more than a tool to make money. Her stepfather even spent all of her college tuition, forcing her to work part-time to pay for her education. While working at a bar, Ella was drugged by a customer, but was rescued by a drunken Edward, leading to a one-night stand. Two months later, Ella discovered she was pregnant! Her stepfather, wanting to sell her off for a good price, attempted to force her into having an abortion. In a critical moment, Edward arrived in time to save Ella and brought her home, offering her care and protection. However, due to her low status, Ella faced insults from Edward's sister and bullying at school. A wealthy heiress, who also had her eyes on Edward, threatened her as well. Yet, Edward remained firm in his commitment to protect her. After overcoming multiple challenges, Ella transformed from a timid, self-conscious girl into a brave and strong woman, gradually winning Edward’s heart. She safely gave birth to their child, and years later, became a brilliant AI researcher.
accidentally-pregnant-forever-spoiled.title: Accidentally Pregnant, Forever Spoiled

after-cancer-i-turn-into-a-badass.text: Evelyn has long been oppressed by her stepsister, misunderstood by her husband, and looked down upon by her family. After being misdiagnosed with terminal cancer, she suddenly comes to her sense and decides to live her final days to the fullest. She turns into a fierce diva, taking revenge on her oblivious husband and her evil stepsister. However, her husband suddenly realizes that he has mistaken someone else for his lifesaver...
after-cancer-i-turn-into-a-badass.title: After Cancer I Turn into A Badass

after-divorce-i-built-a-fabulous-life.text: In After Divorce I Built A Fabulous Life movie, once a talented designer, Mia married Tyler for love and became a housewife post-graduation. However, a three-year marriage ended with a divorce decree. Tyler's heartlessness makes Mia give up hope, leading her to reclaim her beloved career. Eventually, Mia shines in her passion, and Tyler realizes his true feelings, allowing them to rediscover love...
after-divorce-i-built-a-fabulous-life.title: After Divorce, I Built A Fabulous Life

betrayed-alpha-queen-rises-from-the-ashe.text: Nessa, secret Wolf Queen, has her wolf sealed so that she can runaway with her fated mate, Alpha Blaze Ashclaw. But Blaze mistakes the birthmark on their son to mean Nessa cheated and makes them his slaves. Only when the life of their son is threatened, is there a chance for Blaze to realize the truth, but will it be too late then?
betrayed-alpha-queen-rises-from-the-ashe.title: Betrayed Alpha Queen Rises from the Ashes

betraying-my-billionaire-husband.text: When rich heiress Jane Walden's father is imprisoned for fraud, she's left to fight cancer and a secret pregnancy without any money. Wanting to protect her fiance and his new company from her disaster of life, she stages a fake affair in order to get him to fall out of love with her. But years later, even though he's finally a billionaire, Vincent still hasn't forgotten Jane. How does she break it to Vincent that he has a 7-year-old son named Dylan?
betraying-my-billionaire-husband.title: Betraying My Billionaire Husband

billionaire-ceo-s-secret-obsession.text: Dr. Leah Anderson's life is turned upside down when she falls for the hot, seductive billionaire, Ryan Carter, whose obsession makes him a dangerous lover. Their passionate romance takes a dark turn as men in Leah's life begin to mysteriously disappear, and now she must face Ryan's chilling secrets, and confront her love for him.
billionaire-ceo-s-secret-obsession.title: Billionaire CEO's Secret Obsession

boss-me-around-if-you-dare.text: In Boss Me Around If You Dare movie: Just after she is falsely accused of sleeping with her boss and fired, Olivia lands a new job at Wilder Conglomerate—only to realize her new boss is Theo Wilder, the man she hooked up with last night! Olivia says they can’t work together, but Theo challenges her to stay and take a bet: he says he can make her fall for him, while Olivia bets she can resist his seduction… but just how long can she last against her boss’ sexy advances?
boss-me-around-if-you-dare.title: Boss Me Around If You Dare

bound-to-the-rebel-wolf.text: Their families slaughtered each other, and they’re sworn to hate one another… but the pull between them can't be denied. Maeve, the alpha princess, enters Luperiom determined to survive the kingdom’s brutal war college. What she doesn’t expect is a fated bond with Saxon Blackmoor—the most powerful wolf there… and her enemy. Now, the one wolf she shouldn’t want might be the only one who can save her.
bound-to-the-rebel-wolf.title: Bound to the Rebel Wolf

break-my-heart-again.text: Break My Heart Again full movie story about: To protect her lover from the hands of her debtors, Lucie broke up with Felix giving him the wrong perception. Years later, Felix became wealthy and Lucie became his employee. Still angered by their past relationship, he promised to tear her apart and make her feel his pain. What happens when he finds out her true past intentions?
break-my-heart-again.title: Break My Heart Again

breaking-the-deal-with-my-hockey-bad-boy.text: Breaking the Deal with My Hockey Bad Boy movie shows Jane Wellsy has a secret — she's got a crush on her stepbrother Nate Duncan. No one knows except for her worst enemy, hockey badboy Zach Gates. Even worse, Jane finds out Nate's new transfer student girlfriend was her bully from high school, Melissa! When Melissa finds Jane's smutty story and demands to know if it's about Nate, Zach swoops in to save her, kicking off their fake relationship to keep her secret safe. As they spend time together, Jane finds there's a warm, kind heart under Zach's cold bad boy persona, ready to heal her broken heart and face the world at her side...
breaking-the-deal-with-my-hockey-bad-boy.title: Breaking the Deal with My Hockey Bad Boy

captured-and-bound-by-my-ceo.text: In Captured and bound by my CEO movie, Lydia's father is dying and the family's company is drowning. She's the next in line appointed to take over her family's company. Her brother and her boyfriend wouldn't want that to happen. They joined hands with a common enemy, Declan, to bring her down. With Lydia being the longtime crush of Declan, she's about to win over her brother.
captured-and-bound-by-my-ceo.title: Captured and Bound By My CEO

caution-cute-baby-alert.text: In Caution! Cute Baby Alert! movie, One night with Robert the billionaire and Scarlett was pregnant. She never saw him again. Her parents rejected her and her baby was confirmed dead. Unbeknownst to Scarlett, her baby didn't die; instead, he was sold. Years later, a cute baby called her mommy. He wants her to marry his dad who pretends to be a chauffeur.
caution-cute-baby-alert.title: Caution! Cute Baby Alert!

ceo-and-the-country-girl.text: In CEO and the Country Girl movie, when her sister betrays her and a ruthless CEO targets her family farm, fiery small-town cowgirl Avery Rogers clashes—and sparks—with Tyler Sinclair, the corporate heir sent to take her land. But as lust and loyalty collide, a small-town cookout—Tyler’s bold bid to save Avery and her father’s legacy—turns enemies into something dangerously close to lovers, and turning their worlds upside down.
ceo-and-the-country-girl.title: CEO and the Country Girl

corrupting-my-billionaire-boss-s-heart.text: In Corrupting My Billionaire Boss's Heart movie, when Lyla Walker starts working at the world's most elite country club, she unwittingly brings chaos and temptation to her buttoned-up billionaire CEO Royce Kennedy. She's ready to risk everything for their forbidden relationship, unaware of the promise he made to her dying father.
corrupting-my-billionaire-boss-s-heart.title: Corrupting My Billionaire Boss's Heart

countdown-to-life-rescue-at-30-000-feet.text: America’s top billionaire, Derek Wolf, is dying and hires elite surgeon Shaun to bring a donor kidney by plane for a secret transplant. But the flight is delayed when Kim — mother of Jessica, who’s engaged to Derek’s grandson Erik — goes to the bathroom. When Shaun urges them to hurry, Jessica humiliates him. After takeoff, Kim suffers a heart attack, and Shaun saves her, breaking her ribs in the process. Ungrateful, Jessica demands Shaun apologize in a humiliating way. When he refuses, she threatens to destroy the kidney. Forced to reveal Derek’s condition, Shaun pleads, but Jessica doesn’t believe him — until she smashes the case and sees the name on it: Derek Wolf, her own fiancé’s grandfather.
countdown-to-life-rescue-at-30-000-feet.title: Countdown to Life: Rescue at 30000 Feet

daddy-forgot-but-mommy-remembers.text: Nicole loses everything the night she’s framed—her freedom, her child, and the love of her life. Seven years later, she returns as a nanny in the very house that once destroyed her. Ethan, her ex-fiancé, still haunted by the woman he once loved, starts to feel something for the new nanny—without knowing it’s her. Secrets simmer, memories resurface, and Lila, their stolen daughter, is the unexpected thread pulling them back together. He doesn’t remember her. But his heart never forgets.
daddy-forgot-but-mommy-remembers.title: Daddy Forgot, but Mommy Remembers

daddy-i-m-your-lucky-star.text: Lila is five when her uncle Harold and aunt Karen abandon her. Jonathan, a kind billionaire, finds her and takes her home. He adopts her, and from that day, the house feels brighter. Lila brings luck and warmth. Noah, Jonathan’s son, has not spoken for a long time; with Lila by his side, he finally finds his voice. At an auction, she helps Jonathan win a hidden treasure chest. She even “talks” with the family dog and follows the hint to help Noah find his missing violin. When danger rises, Lila “forces” Harold and the schemer Vivienne to tell the truth. The lies fall apart. She helps the family get out of harm’s way, exposes the schemes, and leaves Harold, Karen, and Vivienne with nowhere to hide.
daddy-i-m-your-lucky-star.title: Daddy I'm Your Lucky Star!

daisy-tucker-and-mr-nyc.text: In Daisy Tucker and Mr. NYC movie, after a flash marriage, country girl Daisy finds herself married to her new boss, Hamilton Smith, owner of Smith Media. But misunderstandings and plots by Hamilton's evil VP, Bianca, threaten to destroy their relationship before they can confess that they really love each other.
daisy-tucker-and-mr-nyc.title: Daisy Tucker and Mr. NYC

dear-professor-you-are-my-baby-daddy.text: Med student Cora never expected to get pregnant—let alone with the baby of Damon Hawkins, the city’s most eligible billionaire bachelor... and her new visiting professor. She planned to keep the child a secret, but Damon kept pushing past her walls—until he dropped to one knee and asked her to marry him. What Cora thought would be a fleeting romance turned into a whirlwind of unexpected tenderness and indulgent love. But the closer they grow, the more dangerous secrets begin to surface. As betrayal and hidden bloodlines come to light, Cora must face the ultimate question— Can she truly find happiness... and reunite with the family she never knew she had?
dear-professor-you-are-my-baby-daddy.title: Dear Professor, You Are My Baby Daddy

divorce-tears-from-the-alpha-but-i-shine.text: Ella fell in love with Holden, the Alpha of the High Mountain Wolf Clan, when they were children after he promised to protect her. Due to a witch's prophecy about destined mates, she became his Luna. However, Holden mistakenly thought she married him just to be Luna, so he grew to hate her. Due to the scheming of Ivy, Holden's childhood sweetheart, Ella thinks they're romantically involved and overhears Holden's plan to abort Ella's unborn child. She divorces him and leaves with the baby, then reuniting with her own clan, the Silver Snow Clan, and learns she's their long-lost princess.
divorce-tears-from-the-alpha-but-i-shine.title: Divorce Tears from the Alpha, but I Shine Alone

falling-for-my-divorce-lawyer.text: Evie wants to get away from her abusive, cheating husband, but he refuse to let her go. She finds herself broke and homeless, until she meets Hunter. Can Hunter be the lifeline Evie needs to escape her dangerous asshole husband who'd rather see her die than let her win?
falling-for-my-divorce-lawyer.title: Falling for My Divorce Lawyer

fatal-attraction-a-dark-mafia-romance.text: To avenge her mother, Daisy disguises herself as a dancer to get close to the dangerous mafia boss, Hogan. Despite suspecting Daisy's intentions, Hogan finds himself irresistibly drawn to her deadly charm. Will Daisy manage to walk away unscathed, or will she be entangled in passion with Hogan?
fatal-attraction-a-dark-mafia-romance.title: Fatal Attraction: A Dark Mafia Romance

fatal-attraction-the-hybrid-princess.text: Natalie is a hybrid. She is a werewolf, dragon and vampire, and due to this, she is targeted by different people who are after her for so many reasons in Fatal Temptation: The Hybrid Princess Movie. Following her flee from her pack because of heartbreak, she returns when she hears of the death of her parents and a new Alpha.
fatal-attraction-the-hybrid-princess.title: Fatal Attraction: The Hybrid Princess

fated-to-my-forbidden-vampire.text: Fated to My Forbidden Vampire Summary shows how werewolves are bound by the moon goddess. The movie talks about Theo and Heather who are tied by blood oath. Heather, who was termed as unwanted for being an orphan, is wanted and loved by Theo. Fiona, Heather's sister, conspires a revenge plan to ruin Heather's happiness. Heather has to find a way to break the magic spell to protect her love.
fated-to-my-forbidden-vampire.title: Fated to My Forbidden Vampire

fated-to-my-homeless-billionaire-alpha.text: Elara catches her fiancé, Victor, cheating on her with her best friend, Helena. Devastated, Elara impulsively marries a humble homeless man named Liam. Unbeknownst to Elara, Liam is actually the billionaire Alpha leader of the werewolf world. And he spoils Elara beyond her wildest dreams!
fated-to-my-homeless-billionaire-alpha.title: Fated to My Homeless Billionaire Alpha

fuel-to-our-fire-my-racer-stepbrother.text: In Fuel to Our Fire My Racer Stepbrother movie, struggling to pay the bills to support her ailing mother and abusive step-father, Elaine turns to her work as a dancer at illegal street races. But, as fate would have it, she unknowingly runs into the world's most-feared and envied world-championship street racer... her step-brother. And gives him her virginity.
fuel-to-our-fire-my-racer-stepbrother.title: Fuel to Our Fire: My Racer Stepbrother

genius-baby-gets-daddy-back.text: After a medical mishap, the virgin Violet Gray becomes pregnant with the child of a billionaire stranger, Carter Watts. To provide for the child, they are forced into a hasty marriage. Carter leaves for a business trip and is away for six years, during which Violet raises their son, Patrick, on her own while working at a five-star hotel. Unexpectedly, the hotel is bought out by a mysterious new owner—Carter himself! However, after six years apart, they no longer recognize each other. By chance, Violet discovers that her charming boss, Carter Watts, is actually her long-lost husband...
genius-baby-gets-daddy-back.title: Genius Baby Gets Daddy Back

go-away-stepmom-you-have-it-all-wrong.text: In Go Away Stepmom You Have It All Wrong Movie, on the day of her father’s wedding, Margaret rushes home early from college exams to attend the ceremony. She only to be mistaken by her future stepmother, Chloe, as her father’s mistress. While her father is away, Chloe takes every opportunity to humiliate and mistreat Margaret. Can Margaret clear her name and expose Chloe’s true colors before it’s too late?
go-away-stepmom-you-have-it-all-wrong.title: Go Away Stepmom, You Have It All Wrong!

good-with-her-hands.text: Years after an unexpected separation, Bella and Adam—once college classmates who fell in love at first sight—are unexpectedly reunited. Now a successful doctor, Bella is stunned when Adam, her first love and now a renowned NHL superstar, appears in her office, seeking help. As old feelings resurface, a twist of fate binds them in a contract relationship, giving their unfinished love a second chance. With each passing day, the spark between Bella and Adam grows stronger, but both must decide if this second chance will allow their long-dormant love to flourish into something lasting.
good-with-her-hands.title: Good with Her Hands

goodbye-my-ceo.text: Sophie McKenzie runs straight into the arms of James Knight after she was being pursued by a gang. James Knight takes her in according to Goodbye, My CEO Movie, and offers her protection but that came with a price. However, Sophie wants to break free from this bond, but she finds herself stuck as James Knight refuses to let go.
goodbye-my-ceo.title: Goodbye, My CEO

hate-to-love-you.text: Inspired by the novel by Tijan. After a devastating senior year of high school, Kennedy made two rules for herself. 1. No one will know she's related to her brother and 2. She will never fall for another one of her brother's rivals. When Shay Coleman barges into her life with his irritating and irresistable charm, she's treatened to break both of them...
hate-to-love-you.title: Hate to Love You

hello-let-s-get-married.text: Married moments after meeting for the first time, new couple Maya Moore and Ethan Armstrong attempt to make their spontaneous marriage work despite interference from their enemies and Maya’s mysterious past.
hello-let-s-get-married.title: Hello, Let's Get Married

hillbilly-girlie-marries-a-billionaire.text: In Hillbilly Girlie Marries a Billionaire movie, small-town girl Emily moves to the city to collect a debt from her ex, Kevin, hoping to pay off her mother’s medical bills. But she discovers Kevin is now a sugar baby living off of wealthy woman, Rose, and together they humiliate her. Just as Emily hits rock bottom, she stumbles across Lucas. Through an unexpected misunderstanding, Emily becomes the contract wife of a CEO.
hillbilly-girlie-marries-a-billionaire.title: Hillbilly Girlie Marries a Billionaire

homeless-billionaire-baby-daddy.text: Daisy and Alex share a one night stand and part ways on one fateful night -- which leaves Daisy pregnant. Alex is on his way to her when he gets into a car accident and loses his memory. 5 years later, Daisy runs into a homeless Alex, and her daughter Poppy insists he's her father. When will Daisy realize this homeless man is her baby daddy? Will the family of three work together to take revenge against scheming villains?
homeless-billionaire-baby-daddy.title: Homeless Billionaire Baby Daddy

how-to-kiss-a-vampire.text: In How to Kiss a Vampire movie, eight years after Vincent abandoned her, Ella—now a single mom—is pushed off a rooftop and saved by a mysterious, flying masked man. She wakes up to find Vincent at her side. He denies being the masked man but insists his enemies are targeting her and demands she move in with him for protection. Why is the man who broke her heart now acting like her savior? And why does he seem... not entirely human? Can Ella trust him again—or is he hiding more than just a mask?
how-to-kiss-a-vampire.title: How to Kiss a Vampire

i-accidentally-hired-a-billionaire-husba.text: Online, Emma had agreed to meet a man at a place and time whom she would get married to, and he had told her that he was putting on a green shirt. That was how she met Oliver in I Accidentally Hired A Billionaire Husband Movie, who was coincidentally putting on a green jacket, and running away from getting married.
i-accidentally-hired-a-billionaire-husba.title: I Accidentally Hired a Billionaire Husband

i-flash-married-my-best-friend.text: Chloe and Mateo have been best friends for years, until they accidentally spend one fateful night together and end up in a flash marriage! Will Mateo confess he's been in love with Chloe for years, and pull her out of their "friend-zone"? And what will Chloe do, when she finds out Mateo is secretly a billaionire CEO?
i-flash-married-my-best-friend.title: I Flash-Married My Best Friend?!

i-have-five-kick-ass-brothers.text: In I Have Five Kick-Ass Brothers movie, Raina "Smith" Lincoln has to leave her life of luxury after finding out she was switched at birth. She reunites with her seemingly impoverished biological family, the Lincolns, who hide their extreme wealth from her. Despite finding out that her family is poor, Raina embraces the Lincolns and they reciprocate. As her old family, the Smiths, and their evil daughter try to take her down, her true family, along with super rich, super handsome, billionaire Theo Jones, do anything and everything to defend Raina.
i-have-five-kick-ass-brothers.title: I Have Five Kick-Ass Brothers

i-m-done-being-a-yes-man.text: In I'm Done Being a Yes-Man movie, Enzo is the mysterious heir to the Quinn Corporation. He comes from a prominent family and has an extraordinary talent for football. He is infatuated with the daughter of his family's chauffeur, Stella Hall. One night, Stella gets into an accident from drunk driving, but she convinces Enzo to take the blame for her. Worried that her secret will eventually get out, Stella scams Enzo out of all his savings and hires a killer to murder Enzo. However, just as Enzo is about to die, a mysterious power sends him one month back into the past. Now that Enzo knows Stella's real personality, he's no longer in love with her. Enzo resolves to leave behind his "simp" image and make sure Stella gets what she deserves.
i-m-done-being-a-yes-man.title: I'm Done Being a Yes-Man

i-m-pregnant-let-s-break-up.text: Monica, a talent manager, and Adonis, an A-list star, have been in secret relationship for three years now. For Monica, it's all just unrequited love because Adonis has not even once expressed his feelings to her. Monica, now pregenant, decides to leave this relationship behind. It is only then that Adonis realizes all he needs is her. Years later, their paths cross again, and Monica is now an acclaimed film director. This time, will Adonis win back his love?
i-m-pregnant-let-s-break-up.title: I'm Pregnant, Let's Break Up!

i-married-as-the-replacement-bride.text: Martina is the perfect Mafia daughter. Beautiful, quiet, and — most important of all — obedient. But to protect the one she loves most, she'll go against her father's orders and take her sister's place as bride to the deadliest, most notorious Mafia don of all... the Butcher.
i-married-as-the-replacement-bride.title: I Married as the Replacement Bride

in-love-with-dr-baby-daddy.text: Spencer dumped Jade for a brainy girlfriend. She felt betrayed. They have been together for so long, why now? Infuriated by Spencer's choice, Jade hooks up with a stranger she met at the hospital. Soon, she'll find out that her strange man is her boss and ex-boyfriend's father. She'll also find out that she's pregnant for him.
in-love-with-dr-baby-daddy.title: In Love with Dr. Baby Daddy!

in-love-with-the-alpha.text: After getting her wolf, Maya learns that the alpha of her pack, Liam, is her fated mate. Meanwhile, the evil Rogue King searches for the True Luna who will be his bride, to make his power complete and help usher in a reign of darkness. Maya is this True Luna, and she must reckon with her destiny and the danger and transformation it brings.
in-love-with-the-alpha.title: In Love with the Alpha

infatuated-with-the-ceo.text: Infatuated With The CEO movie talks about Emma Caldwell who ends up sleeping with August Hughes, her business partner, after finding out her fiancé Derek is cheating on her. To save herself from the scandal she pretends to be with Derek who manipulates her into not breaking up with him. August Hughes, despite being called a Casanova by the tabloids, chases after Emma, wanting her to be more than a one-night stand.
infatuated-with-the-ceo.title: Infatuated with the CEO

kiss-me-99-times-a-day.text: In Kiss Me 99 Times a Day movie, Alice Breslin, desperate to ditch a sleazy guy, impulsively kisses CEO Anson Vega. The next thing she knows, he whisks her away and they get married on the spot. After their whirlwind wedding, they slowly start developing feelings for each other as they spend their days together. In a dramatic twist, Anson unexpectedly discovers that the genius "Sam" he's been searching for all along is actually Alice.
kiss-me-99-times-a-day.title: Kiss Me 99 Times a Day

lassoed-by-a-cowboy-s-love.text: In Lassoed by a Cowboy's Love movie, Madison was a Manhattan heiress with it all—until she loses everything, including her now-cruel fiancé who stranded her in Texas. Broke and desperate, Madison wanders into a local saloon…and into the arms of Beau Hayes—her ex’s rugged, dangerously sexy cowboy uncle. After a steamy night, Beau offers her a job -- and an unexpected shelter. Now Madison’s trading pearls for cowboy boots, riding bulls, horses—and maybe even a cowboy.
lassoed-by-a-cowboy-s-love.title: Lassoed by a Cowboy's Love

leaving-my-alpha-husband-in-ice-cold-reg.text: When Snow discovers her alpha husband cheating, she offers herself as ritual sacrifice to be eternally frozen. And when she leaves, she will finally break their mate-bond, leaving ice cold regret to be his new forever mate! But what will he do to bring her back?
leaving-my-alpha-husband-in-ice-cold-reg.title: Leaving My Alpha Husband in Ice Cold Regret

mafia-boss-takes-high-school.text: When a High Level Mafioso finds himself in the body of a bullied high schooler, he uses it as a second chance at finishing high school. But will his street smarts help him to fulfill his dream of going to college, or will a group of bullies drive him to drop out again?
mafia-boss-takes-high-school.title: Mafia Boss Takes High School

mafia-s-tender-torture.text: Vesper, who is determined to raise money to save her father, finds Raymond, the boss of the Hell Gang, to become his contracted lover. However, Vesper doesn't know that Raymond has been secretly in love with her for many years. How can they overcome the misunderstandings between money and love...
mafia-s-tender-torture.title: Mafia's Tender Torture

married-for-green-card-stayed-for-love.text: Leslie Madison dated her boyfriend for two years in Married For Green Card, Stayed For Love Movie, so when she became desperate for a green card, she thought her boyfriend would get married to her, instead he broke up with her. Leslie eventually married someone who needed her as much as she needed him, Simon Williams. They fell in love.
married-for-green-card-stayed-for-love.title: Married for Green Card, Stayed for Love

mistaken-as-his-mate-the-luna-s-regret.text: In Mistaken as His Mate The Luna’s Regret movie, Alpha Caspian’s pregnant sister Marina arrives for his Luna’s coronation, but Luna Willow mistakes her for a rogue mistress. In a jealous rage, Willow bullies Marina, causing her miscarriage. Now the Brooks siblings want blood.
mistaken-as-his-mate-the-luna-s-regret.title: Mistaken as His Mate: The Luna's Regret

monster-in-his-eyes.text: In Monster in His Eyes movie, based on the book MONSTER IN HIS EYES by J.M. Darhower! Karissa Reed, 19, is trapped by her controlling mother and abusive ex, Tommy, but her world shifts when Naz Conti, a dangerous ex-con mafia boss, rescues her. Drawn to his danger, she challenges him to let her be his, with every kiss and daring move, risking everything for desire, curiosity, and forbidden love. Can she survive his world, and dare to love the man everyone warns her to fear?
monster-in-his-eyes.title: Monster in His Eyes

my-billionaire-ever-after.text: Aria Walker needs a husband to get out of an arranged marriage. When her long-term boyfriend reveals he's leaving her for her best friend, a heartbroken Aria turns to old acquaintance/"food truck worker," Norman Hill. Little does she know Norman Hill is actually a billionaire CEO. Aria's selfish family and bitter best friend try to sabotage her at every turn, but with Norman's support, Aria's marriage only gets stronger.
my-billionaire-ever-after.title: My Billionaire Ever After

my-boss-is-my-secret-sperm-donor.text: In My Boss Is My Secret Sperm Donor movie, Leia, struggling with infertility, is caught slacking off at work by her boss, Alec, while browsing a sperm donor website. Mortified by the encounter, she tries to move on. After carefully selecting a donor at the sperm bank, fate takes an unexpected turn—she ends up choosing Alec’s donation without realizing it. When will Leia discover that the child she’s carrying is actually Alec’s?
my-boss-is-my-secret-sperm-donor.title: My Boss Is My Secret Sperm Donor

my-dark-romeo.text: After Romeo Costa ruins Dallas Townsend's reputation at the debutante ball and forces her into a marriage, Dallas makes a new plan: seduce him, break his rule, and get the family she’s always dreamed of. But Romeo is not easy to break. And Dallas isn't the type of girl to give up.
my-dark-romeo.title: My Dark Romeo

my-dear-brother-is-obsessed-with-me.text: Clyde enlists small time actress, Violet, to play the role of his long-lost sister, fulfilling his father's dying wish. Together, they face constant scrutiny and challenges from the antagonist. Living together , they inadvertently developed a forbidden romance. Determined to prove their taboo relationship, the antagonist sought to tarnish their reputation, leading Clyde's father to arrange Violet's marriage to another. In a desperate bid to reclaim their love, Clyde resolved to interrupt the wedding ceremony...
my-dear-brother-is-obsessed-with-me.title: My Dear Brother is Obsessed With Me

my-husband-regrets-divorcing-me.text: In My Husband Regrets Divorcing Me movie, Audrey hides her identity as a CEO to protect Cornell's pride, working behind the scenes to help him secure a major hotel project and climb to the top as the hotel's CEO. As she helps him make his way up the ladder, his first love, Cecilia, returns, putting a strain on their relationship . Meanwhile, Audrey faces relentless pressure from those around her, including Cornell, which pushing her to consider a divorce. After enduring countless humiliations, she finally recognizes her worth and the price of dedicating herself to the wrong person. With her confidence restored, Audrey eventually chooses divorce and fight to reclaim her place as the CEO.
my-husband-regrets-divorcing-me.title: My Husband Regrets Divorcing Me

my-stolen-billionaire-life.text: Switched at birth, Allie had no idea who she really was until she fell for Xander Maddox. That's when she gets her DNA results. Now, she's torn between telling Xander who her father really is and risk losing him or keeping a lie from the man she loves.
my-stolen-billionaire-life.title: My Stolen Billionaire Life

nanny-to-my-hot-bully.text: In Nanny to My Hot Bully movie, Abbi is Felix's rival... and nanny. Things take a complicated turn when she moves into his house to care for him and his sister and Felix and Abbi realize their feelings for each other. Can Abbi hide her feelings for Felix to keep her nannying job?
nanny-to-my-hot-bully.title: Nanny to My Hot Bully

nero-made-men.text: Based on the novel by Sarah Brianne. Elle's life is turned upside down when Nero, the untouchable bad boy, swoops in to save her from her school bully. One smile from him makes every girl swoon, Elle couldn't believe he wants her. Gazing into his eyes, she wonders if this notorious bad boy could be trusted... How was she to know that she was just a part of Nero's mission, as the heir to a Mafia Empire? As for Nero, he has somehow fallen head over heels for this girl who has no idea the danger she was in.
nero-made-men.title: Nero: Made Men

never-reject-a-wolf-princess.text: In Never Reject A Wolf Princess movie: Lia was born a princess, but all she really wants is a life of her own. So she chooses love over duty—only to be betrayed and rejected by her mate. But she’s not one to stay broken for long. When she unexpectedly bonds with a new mate hiding his own secrets, Lia is thrust into a world of power, deception, and second chances. Now, she’s done following the rules. It’s time to reclaim her throne—and make everyone who doubted her regret it!
never-reject-a-wolf-princess.title: Never Reject A Wolf Princess

never-underestimate-girl-math.text: In Never Underestimate Girl movie Math, Zosha is a poor orphan who gets bullied by all the rich Ivy League kids for working on a farm. But Zosha's about to beat them all at the one thing they least expect: math.
never-underestimate-girl-math.title: Never Underestimate Girl Math

omg-i-got-married-in-vegas.text: Look at how Emily Grace and William Valcor ran away from their engagement, only for them to still end up getting married to themselves in OMG! I Got Married In Vegas Movie. After declaring that they were both too spoilt for each other, Emily and William, unknown to them that they were the runaway bride and groom, eventually got married.
omg-i-got-married-in-vegas.title: OMG, I Got Married in Vegas!

omg-i-m-surrounded-by-three-princes.text: Erin, a down-and-out street vendor, is betrayed by her fiancé and best friend, but no one knows that her true identity is the long-lost princess. Just when the three princes find the clues and Erin can return to the royal family, her true princess identity is claimed by her best friend. In the many subsequent dangerous situations, Prince Charles repeatedly protects Erin, causing Erin to develop a different feeling for her "brother" Charles.
omg-i-m-surrounded-by-three-princes.title: OMG, I'm Surrounded by Three Princes

oops-i-m-in-love-with-my-stepbrother.text: Olivia and Finn are total opposites - she's a studious, artistic good girl, and he's a rebellious party animal straight out of rehab. But when they hook up the night before Olivia's dad marries Finn's mom, they realize they have one thing in common: their obsession with each other. Can Olivia put her feelings for her bad boy stepbrother aside?
oops-i-m-in-love-with-my-stepbrother.title: Oops! I'm in Love with My Stepbrother

operation-christmas-trap.text: In Operation Christmas Trap movie, six years ago, Winnie and Logan fell in love and had twin daughters. But after Selina sowed discord between them, a misunderstanding drove the couple apart. Six years later, with a little help from their twin daughters swapping places, the truth comes to light.
operation-christmas-trap.title: Operation Christmas Trap

playing-by-the-billionaire-s-rules.text: Playing By the Billionaire’s Rules Movie is about Becky Jacobs who had a contract affair with Nick Walton for three years with rules. One of the rules was that they would not fall in love but they both broke it and found it difficult to maneuver Nick’s mother who wanted him to marry someone else for an alliance to ensue.
playing-by-the-billionaire-s-rules.title: Playing by the Billionaire's Rules

pregnant-by-my-ex-s-dad.text: In Pregnant by My Ex's Dad movie, Lucia's boyfriend cheats on her with her best friend, Brooklyn. It was a day to their residency, and catching them cheating broke Lucia. Pregnant by My Ex's Dad trailer shows Lucia lost in the arms of her ex's dad a few hours later. What she didn't know was that one encounter with him would lead to her getting pregnant.
pregnant-by-my-ex-s-dad.title: Pregnant by My Ex's Dad

pretty-baby.text: In Pretty Baby movie, Rosy Dolores, the city's most sought-after escort, enters a fake engagement with billionaire single father Tad Williams to locate the daughter ripped away from her at birth. Unbeknownst to her, Tad's charming daughter, Lily, is the very child she's been searching for.
pretty-baby.title: Pretty Baby

puck-me-baby-one-more-time.text: Lila Cobb once saved Alexander Vaughn, the hottest hockey player. One night of passion between them left her unexpectedly pregnant. Eight months later, Lila was cast out of her family and gave birth to a premature baby boy. Struggling to pay the hospital bills, she worked herself to the bone. Meanwhile, Alexander has been searching for Lila all along, determined to give her and their child all the love he has. But will he be able to find them before it’s too late?
puck-me-baby-one-more-time.title: Puck Me Baby One More Time

queen-mom-rules.text: At her parents' anniversary party, a successful CEO is dismissed as a low-class nobody, her diamond gift called fake, and she's even banned from the table!
queen-mom-rules.title: Queen Mom Rules

queen-of-the-court.text: In Queen of the Court movie, after abandoning her career as a tennis star, Lily Pearson dedicated her life to helping her boyfriend Adam's tennis career. But after helping him win his own Grand Slam...the fame changed Adam for the worse. Adam's not only involved with a younger tennis star Mia Sparks, but he wants Lily to coach her as well. Will Lily accept this betrayal and love a cheating man she no longer recognizes, or will she have the courage to leave, and salvage her potential from all those years ago?
queen-of-the-court.title: Queen of the Court

reborn-for-the-lycan-king.text: In Reborn for the Lycan King movie, reborn after her stepsister’s deadly betrayal, Diana shoots an arrow to choose her mate. It lands on Alexander, the hidden Lycan King. But with Ivy still plotting and her bond with Alex unclear, Diana must fight to change her fate—before it’s too late.
reborn-for-the-lycan-king.title: Reborn for the Lycan King

rented-a-billionaire-husband-for-christm.text: In Rented a Billionaire Husband for Christmas movie, seven years ago, they shared one night. Now they’re fake-married—with a child he doesn’t know is his.
rented-a-billionaire-husband-for-christm.title: Rented a Billionaire Husband for Christmas

return-of-the-reaper.text: Isaac Kane is a single father with a dark secret: he was once the most feared killer on the planet. After making a vow to his dying wife to never kill again, he now spends his days as a down-on-his-luck single father. But when his daughter is kidnapped by a major crime family, he must break his vow... and kill his way through the Russian Mafia, while re-taking his place as a near-mythic killer that haunts the nightmares of the wicked.
return-of-the-reaper.title: Return of the Reaper

rules-of-protection-the-bodyguard-i-hate.text: In Rules of Protection The Bodyguard I Hate movie, Elena and Ace used to be engaged for marriage. But, after Ace is disabled from the war, he pretends to cheat on Elena to save her from his new disability. Three years pass until the CEO of a medical insurance company gets shot. Elena needs a personal bodyguard, and Ace just happens to be the one for the job. Will Elena and Ace repair their rocky past and reignite the love they once had for each other?
rules-of-protection-the-bodyguard-i-hate.title: Rules of Protection: The Bodyguard I Hate

runaway-billionaire-becomes-my-groom.text: Left heartbroken at the altar, Liana impulsively marries Jacob, a mysterious billionaire hiding his own pain. What begins as a cold agreement transforms into a journey of passion and healing. As they navigate meddling exes, family drama, and corporate battles, will their whirlwind romance blossom into true love, or will their pasts tear them apart?
runaway-billionaire-becomes-my-groom.title: Runaway Billionaire Becomes My Groom

ruthless-mafia-daddy.text: The day Ellie's IVF process is a success, she finds out her fiance and her best friend are having an affair. Devastated, she decides to raise her child alone. The doctor reveals there's been a mix up at the sperm bank - she's pregnant with the Mafia Boss' baby. Ellie has been unwillingly dragged into a mafia war of succession. In order to protect her unborn baby, she agrees to a contract marriage with the mafia boss. They never thought this would lead them to true love.
ruthless-mafia-daddy.title: Ruthless Mafia Daddy

sadness-knows-no-boundaries.text: In Sadness Knows No Boundaries movie, Charlotte Hasting's life is turned upside down after her daughter dies due to her husband's negligence and favoritism for a pretty employee. To make matters worse, her husband won't believe her, and thinking that she's hiding their daughter from him, continuously makes her life a living hell.
sadness-knows-no-boundaries.title: Sadness Knows No Boundaries

saved-by-the-sexy-cowboy.text: In Saved by the Sexy Cowboy movie, Ava is on the run from her abusive ex, who will stop at nothing to get her back. But then she encounters a sexy cowboy who saves her and teaches her how a woman is supposed to be loved. Can Ava learn to love again or will her abusive ex catch her before she has the chance?
saved-by-the-sexy-cowboy.title: Saved by the Sexy Cowboy

secret-strangers-in-love.text: When the fate of a business marriage seems inevitable, Emma Watson, the heiress of the Watson family, takes on an internship at Anderson Corporation. Meanwhile, Ethan Anderson, the heir of the Anderson family, steps in as the new CEO. Both hide their true identities while evaluating each other, but they unexpectedly fall in love at first sight. However, things take an unexpected turn when someone else mistakenly claims Emma’s identity, and she mistakenly believes another man is her “fiancé.” Determined, both Emma and Ethan set out to break off their "engagements" with their so-called "fiancés." Will they ever realize that the person they're searching for has been right in front of them all along?
secret-strangers-in-love.title: Secret Strangers in Love

selling-my-virginity-to-the-mafia-king.text: In Selling My Virginity to the Mafia King movie, desperate to save her dying sister, Tessa agrees to auction off her virginity -- only to be claimed by the most dangerous man in the Mafia. Will she ever be able to trust the man who bought her love... or will trusting him cost her everything?
selling-my-virginity-to-the-mafia-king.title: Selling My Virginity to the Mafia King

sit-down-be-humble.text: Stacy Van Ness, the heiress to the biggest winery in Napa Valley, conceals her identity to be with Pete Davis, just to get brutally dumped. She decides to show the world who she is - the richest heiress in the country...but no one seems to believe her?
sit-down-be-humble.title: Sit Down, Be Humble

someone-loved-is-never-lost.text: For seven years, Christmas meant grief––until Raphael Stone sees a face he thought he'd never see again. Lucy, his beloved wife, is alive, but she can't move or talk anymore. Worse, she doesn't seem to remember him at all. Will true love triumph over pain and misfortune?
someone-loved-is-never-lost.title: Someone Loved is Never Lost

stop-crying-i-married-someone-better.text: Scarlett Winters is devastated when her fiancé, Carlton Simmons, abandons her at the altar. Fleeing in humiliation, she’s nearly hit by a car, an incident orchestrated by Leo Forester, genius and legendary CEO who recognizes the runaway bride. Leo offers her an unusual solution: a contract marriage to help her regain her dignity and rebuild her life. As Scarlett heals, Leo secretly supports her, hiding his true identity and intentions. But when old enemies resurface and buried secrets emerge, Scarlett feels betrayed and considers leaving. Now Leo must decide: confess his feelings or risk losing her forever.
stop-crying-i-married-someone-better.title: Stop Crying, I Married Someone Better

stop-that-homeless-man-is-an-american-he.text: In Stop That Homeless Man Is an American Hero movie, Ethan escorts his fallen comrade's ashes back home. On the way, he gets stopped by the local Sheriff who accuses Ethan of being a homeless vagrant. Ethan gets dragged in for questioning at the police station. They humiliate and torture him, but Ethan endures because he must protect his friend's ashes. But then, the sheriff goes too far. He desecrates the ashes! Just when things are about to take a turn for the worse, Ethan's old army subordinate– now the Director of the FBI– appears! Will Ethan's true identity as an American hero finally be revealed?
stop-that-homeless-man-is-an-american-he.title: Stop! That Homeless Man Is an American Hero!

straight-a-pregnancy.text: After a one-night stand with Ben, the hottest guy on campus, Kelsey realizes she's pregnant...and decides to keep the baby. But will Ben stick around - or will he stay a flirty fratboy forever?
straight-a-pregnancy.title: Straight A Pregnancy

super-godfather-my-ex-begs-me-on-her-kne.text: Cain Hunter is a broken man after his wife betrays him and ruins him financially. Just as all hope is lost, Cain is suddenly brought to the mysterious Don Ludwig, who makes him an offer: pass his tests, and Cain will succeed him as the new Godfather of Bourne Syndicate.
super-godfather-my-ex-begs-me-on-her-kne.title: Super Godfather: My Ex Begs Me on Her Knees

taming-my-bullies-3.text: Rowan and Emma's relationship reaches a new stage, but new challenges lie ahead. Will they finally get their happy ending? Emma and The Big Four's story is coming to its finale. Stay tuned for the ending you've been waiting for.
taming-my-bullies-3.title: Taming My Bullies 3

taming-the-lion-billionaire-on-bikes.text: Taming the Lion: Billionaire on Bikes summary is all about Leo Striker, a sexy biker who saves Kara when being harassed by her ex-boyfriend. Kara falls for Leo as he helps her learn how to protect herself. However, Leo is a dominant who wants Kara. Can Kara enjoy being submissive? Kara and Leo's romance is steamy, the biker gang trope is refreshing.
taming-the-lion-billionaire-on-bikes.title: Taming the Lion: Billionaire on Bikes

tempting-the-mafia-twins.text: In Tempting the Mafia Twins movie, Genesis discovers her mob boss husband, Kiefer's affair, and loses one of her twin babies due to his mistress' schemes. Genesis reports him to the authorities and flees while still pregnant. Seven years later, Genesis runs into Kiefer on the street. She thinks her murderous husband is going to kill her, but when Kiefer drags her back home against her will, she realizes the truth: Seven years ago, it was all a misunderstanding. Kiefer O’Reilly, the ruthless mafia boss, only wants one thing—to win Genesis’s love back.
tempting-the-mafia-twins.title: Tempting the Mafia Twins

the-alpha-s-daughter.text: “The Alpha’s Daughter” Daphne Sinclair’s life shatters when her father, a powerful Alpha, is murdered on her 18th birthday. Betrayal by Alpha Atlas fuels her desire for revenge. Identity, transformation, power, and resilience collide. Daphne navigates a hostile environment, forging alliances and seeking justice. New situations are stressful, avoiding danger at the same time sucks. Survival game?
the-alpha-s-daughter.title: The Alpha's Daughter

the-bad-ass-heiress-returns-after-divorc.text: Framed for cheating and losing her 8-month-old unborn baby, Sophia vows to get revenge on those who ruined her life—Ryan Allister and Lana Sullivan. When the Sullivan family tracks her down and reveals she's the real heiress, not Lana, Sophia sees her chance to make her ex-husband and the faker pay. She hides her newfound identity and starts her quest for revenge. Along the way, Ryan realizes he can't live without Sophia and he was fooled by Lana in the beginning.
the-bad-ass-heiress-returns-after-divorc.title: The Bad-ass Heiress Returns After Divorce

the-billionaire-firefighter-and-his-swee.text: In The Billionaire Firefighter and His Sweet Wife Movie, on the wedding day, a fire breaks out. Chloe's fiancé, Kevin, abandons her to save his stepsister, Rachel, leaving her in danger. Leo rushes into the flames to rescue her. To reclaim her mother’s inheritance, Chloe impulsively marries Leo, unaware that he’s actually a billionaire CEO. As time passes, Leo begins to fall for Chloe ultimately becoming utterly devoted to her.
the-billionaire-firefighter-and-his-swee.title: The Billionaire Firefighter and His Sweet Wife

the-day-the-champion-racer-lost-his-brid.text: In The Day the Champion Racer Lost His Bride movie, for five years, Alexis poured her entire heart into Ryder Kane—the golden boy of the racing world. She thought they were building a future together. But on the day she planned to propose, she learned the truth: Ryder never saw her as a partner. Just a placeholder. A “practice girlfriend.” Shattered, Alexis accepts an unexpected proposal from billionaire Everett Hale—and cuts Ryder out of her life for good. Now Ryder is forced to face the fallout. Will he let her walk away… or will losing her push him into a spiral of obsession, regret, and the fight of his life?
the-day-the-champion-racer-lost-his-brid.title: The Day the Champion Racer Lost His Bride

the-deaf-heiress-s-secret.text: In The Deaf Heiress's Secret movie, A deaf heiress regains her hearing just in time to discover the people closest to her plotting against her. Keeping her recovery a secret, she plays a dangerous game of deception against those who believe her disability makes her weak. As she investigates suspicious events from her past, she must carefully navigate a web of betrayal while pretending not to hear the conspiracies unfolding around her in order to bring those who wronged her to justice.
the-deaf-heiress-s-secret.title: The Deaf Heiress's Secret

the-divorced-wife-is-a-genius-surgeon.text: 8 months pregnant, Alyssa is abandoned by her husband for his mistress and their lovechild Lilly. Little do they know, Alyssa is actually Jane Davenport M.D.--heiress to the Davenport fortune, and the only heart surgeon in the world that can save Lilly.
the-divorced-wife-is-a-genius-surgeon.title: The Divorced Wife is a Genius Surgeon

the-genius-and-the-bad-boy.text: In The Genius and the Bad Boy movie, when two hot brothers go after plus size Sophie, will she pick the true-hearted bad boy or the lying quarterback?
the-genius-and-the-bad-boy.title: The Genius and the Bad Boy

the-hacker-heiress-strikes-back.text: In The Hacker Heiress Strikes Back movie, in a previous life, heiress Emily was a genius in the hacker field. In a global competition, fake heiress Olivia accuses Emily of plagiarism, which totally destroys her reputation. Her family believes these false accusations and kicks Emily out of the house. In the end, she’s killed by fake heiress Olivia. In her second life, not only does Emily cut off her ties with her blind to the truth family, but she also gives Fake Heiress Olivia who was falsely accusing her of plagiarism a slap in the face.
the-hacker-heiress-strikes-back.title: The Hacker Heiress Strikes Back

the-hart-breaker.text: Nerdy girl Pearl is determined to catch the eye of her longtime crush, but is clueless on how to do it. But after a shocking encounter with Ethan Hart, the school's biggest bad boy, she makes a deal with him that will finally get her noticed. With his help, Pearl catches the attention of the guy she wants and sparks do fly... but in the wrong direction.
the-hart-breaker.title: The Hart-Breaker

the-heiress-and-her-possessive-bodyguard.text: Three years ago, Jack Hawkins saved heiress Grace Christensen from an evil stalker, but when they reunite, a misunderstanding turns them into enemies. Now, with Grace's safety threatened again, her father hires Jack as her personal bodyguard. When they're forced to spend every second together, will they be able to resist each other?
the-heiress-and-her-possessive-bodyguard.title: The Heiress and Her Possessive Bodyguard

the-janitor-billionaire-his-swapped-brid.text: After Nora's stepsister Bianca steals her AI-matched partner, Nora is forced to marry a janitor and becomes the laughingstock of her family. Little does she know that the janitor is the billionaire behind the AI matchmaking system, using their marriage to test her true feelings...
the-janitor-billionaire-his-swapped-brid.title: The Janitor Billionaire & His Swapped Bride

the-lost-son-returns-as-the-duke.text: In The Lost Son Returns as the Duke movie: Kidnapped as a child, Arthur, Duke of Mercia, returns to his village to reunite with his long-lost family. What he didn't expect was to find them abused by everyone in town. With his identity a secret, will Arthur be able to avenge them?
the-lost-son-returns-as-the-duke.title: The Lost Son Returns as the Duke

the-nurse-s-secret-marriage.text: In The Nurse's Secret Marriage Full Movie, Nurse Aria Browne gets married to billionaire CEO Mason Adams to raise money for her dying mother's operation. Purely contractual, the two never actually see each other during their courthouse ceremony. They meet again three years later - Mason, as the owner of Aria's workplace, and Aria, as the nurse who saved Mason's grandpa's life. They don't recognize each other, but their feelings for each other grow as they spend more time together. Falling for his grandpa's nurse, Mason decides to divorce his wife who, unbeknownst to him, is the very woman he's falling in love with.
the-nurse-s-secret-marriage.title: The Nurse's Secret Marriage

the-price-of-loving-you.text: Pregnant with Alpha Cyrus's child, the only thing that can save Ally Jones's life is the sacred fruit of the Arbor Vitae. But her true mate Cyrus only seems to care about another werewolf, Emma. As Ally's body grows weaker, will Cyrus choose her... just this once?
the-price-of-loving-you.title: The Price of Loving You

the-quarterback-s-first-love.text: In The Quarterback’s First Love movie, after her quarterback fiancee’s betrayal, cheerleader Maddie’s life unravels. Drawn to Cameron, another football player who feels oddly familiar, she faces new challenges as her ex, the cheer captain, and Cameron's mother plot to tear them apart.
the-quarterback-s-first-love.title: The Quarterback's First Love

the-return-of-my-mafia-husband.text: The Return of My Mafia Husband movie summary is all about Leo Marino who keeps his identity as the don of the Marino family as he dates Olivia Gray, an ordinary girl. After being in a coma for eight years, he finds Olivia still waiting by his side as he proposes to her. But a don can't marry a nobody as he promises to give Olivia the world.
the-return-of-my-mafia-husband.title: The Return of My Mafia Husband

the-secret-of-my-billion-dollar-marriage.text: Emma, the heiress of the Coffman family ​​who is dumped by her ex, meets Lucas, the billionaire of the Fischer family, in a strip club. At this time, she happened to meet her ex and his cheating partner again. In order to slap her fiancé in the face, Emma asked Lucas to pretend to be her husband, and Lucas took advantage of the situation and proposed a fake marriage. But Emma thinks Lucas is a stripper/escort, and Lucas thinks Emma is a ghetto girl/gold digger. Both of them misunderstand each other, and they don't want to reveal their identities. Therefore, they must carefully conceal their identities from each other during the process of getting along after marriage, and at the same time fight against two villains who are always causing obstacles. In the process, they gradually create sparks, resolve misunderstandings, and eventually move towards a real marriage.
the-secret-of-my-billion-dollar-marriage.title: The Secret of My Billion-dollar Marriage

the-three-badasses-who-want-me.text: You just got dumped by your cheating husband who doesn’t realize you are actually British royalty! Your dad finds you 3 badass fiancés to show him up. But you only have 7 days to pick! Who do you choose? Or can you have all three?
the-three-badasses-who-want-me.title: The Three Badasses Who Want Me

the-virgin-stripper-and-the-hockey-star.text: In The Virgin Stripper and the Hockey Star movie, Jenna leads a double life: by day, she’s a quiet, unassuming student; by night, she secretly works as a stripper to pay for her sister’s medical bills. Her worlds collide one night when Casper, her cocky school rival and the star of the hockey team, walks into the club. He’s instantly drawn to the enigmatic dancer, Angel, unaware she’s the same girl he spars with at school. But the deeper their bond grows, the closer they come to unraveling each other’s truths.
the-virgin-stripper-and-the-hockey-star.title: The Virgin Stripper and the Hockey Star

the-woman-starts-the-war.text: In The Woman Starts The War movie, when nurse Cindy gets caught in a deadly mafia shootout, ruthless crime boss Allan D'Angelo saves her life by declaring she's his fiancée. Now she's a prisoner in his world - living in his mansion, wearing his ring, and playing a role that could get her killed.
the-woman-starts-the-war.title: The Woman Starts The War

the-words.text: In The Words movie, based on the novel by Ashley Jade. 4 years ago, rocker bad-boy Phoenix broke nerdy good-girl Lennon's heart and stole her song to escape his abusive father. Now he's a famous rockstar, spiraling into drugs and alcohol, she's hired to keep him sober for 8 weeks on tour. Can Lennon and Phoenix heal old wounds, or will their past stand in the way of their second chance at love?
the-words.title: The Words

their-brother-lost-in-space.text: In Their Brother Lost in Space movie, Timothy, adopted by the wealthy Snyder family, grows up devoted to his three older sisters — until the day their biological son, Matthew, returns and turns them against him with lies and manipulation. Cast out and blamed for things he never did, Timothy still repays their kindness: he saves them, sacrifices for them, and even secretly volunteers for Project Hail Mary, a mission to save humanity by sending one person with a rare gene into find a new planet. Only after he's gone, do the Snyders discover the truth about Matthew's schemes and Timothy's sacrifices. Thirty years later, Timothy succeeds on Planet Artemis, honored as a hero while his grieving family lives with the cost of their betrayal.
their-brother-lost-in-space.title: Their Brother Lost in Space

three-brothers-spoil-me.text: Nancy, the long-lost Lancaster heiress, battles betrayal from her boyfriend Alan and his mistress Mia, who try to steal her place. When will Nancy establish her true identity and gain acceptance from those around her?
three-brothers-spoil-me.title: Three Brothers Spoil Me

tutoring-my-rival-boy.text: In Tutoring My Rival Boy movie, Life isn't easy for Chris Blanning, valedictorian at a snobby private school. It's hard enough dealing with bullies already, but when his scholarship isn't enough to cover tuition, he's got to tutor his worst enemy — Lucien Alaric, the spoiled bad boy he just saw trying to seduce their teacher into changing his grades! Even worse, Lucien's figured out his deepest, dirtiest secret in return. All he can do is keep his friends close, and enemies closer — but maybe Chris is getting a little too close...
tutoring-my-rival-boy.title: Tutoring My Rival Boy

two-alphas-are-in-love-with-me.text: The wolfless Lyra, has been captive in the Wolfsbane pack for seven years, during which she was constantly abused by Alpha Roland. During one of her escapes, Lyra has an accidental one-night stand with Alpha Alfred, Moonshadow pack's strongest Alpha, and becomes pregnant with his child. Alpha Alfred rescues Lyra from Alpha Roland and brings her back to his pack. To protect her, Alfred and Lyra form a Fake Luna contract.
two-alphas-are-in-love-with-me.title: Two Alphas Are in Love with Me

unexpected-knot-married-to-a-billionaire.text: After learning that her boyfriend is cheating on her and is only after her fortune, Madeline decides to break up with him and accidentally gets married to Caden, a male nurse. She thought both of them were just hard-working poor people, but she gradually realized that her husband seemed to have hidden wealth and power.Caden Wilson Cashmore, the mysterious CEO of the group, became a male nurse volunteer in order to fulfill his brother's last wish. He's been searching for the recipient of his brother's heart, and could that person be the wife he married on the spur of the moment?
unexpected-knot-married-to-a-billionaire.title: Unexpected Knot: Married to a Billionaire Nurse

waterboy.text: Student Body President Kaden Russell just made an enemy of Star Quarterback Donovan Miller. When the two clash over school activity funds, Donovan goes too far with a cruel remark. As revenge, Kaden dyes the football uniforms rainbow. But when the prank gets Donovan injured during a game, Kaden is sentenced to serve as Donovan’s “waterboy”. The forced proximity stirs up feelings Donovan never expected, and when their rivalry turns romantic, both boys have to decide what they’re willing to risk for love.
waterboy.title: Waterboy

what-doesn-t-break-me.text: Raised in rural poverty, Taylor gets into MIT, but her father and older brother rip up the acceptance letter and sell her to an old rich man for cash. With help from her mom and little sister, Taylor escapes—but loses all contact with them. Seven years later, Taylor is the richest person in the world. She returns home in glory—only to find her mom beaten and her sister sold by her brother. Fueled by rage, Taylor shows up at the welcome banquet held for the world’s top CEO—her brother, now her employee, doesn’t recognize her and calls her a whore in front of everyone. Can Taylor prove who she is, find her sister, and bring justice to those who crushed her? And when the truth comes out—what punishment awaits those who looked down upon Taylor?
what-doesn-t-break-me.title: What Doesn't Break Me

when-love-walked-away.text: Adrian leaves his own daughter Esther in a car while he hangs out with his childhood sweetheart, Stacy and her son Lucas. Under the hot summer sun, the car overheats and shuts down. The A/C stops working and Esther starts to overheat. She's at risk of heatstroke and almost faints. Esther dials Adrian's phone to ask for help. Without listening to her, Adrian hangs up. Just before Esther's tablet runs out of battery, she calls her mother. She begs her mom to save her. However, before Esther can tell Claire her location, the tablet dies. Claire starts to desperately search for her daughter. Will Claire be able to successfully find and save her daughter before the unthinkable happens?
when-love-walked-away.title: When Love Walked Away

when-wife-won-t-forgive.text: In When Wife Won't Forgive movie, on their 25th wedding anniversary, Anne discovers her bestselling author husband, Jonathan, has been having an affair. Anne is fed up and wants to get a divorce. Jonathan thinks he's going to become the CEO of the publishing company, so he immediately kicks Anne to the curb. Utterly heartbroken, Anne decides she won't forgive Jonathan again. She resumes her position as Chairwoman of an elite publishing company, and removes Jonathan from his position. Jonathan finally realizes that Anne who played housewife for 25 years was actually a wealthy heiress.
when-wife-won-t-forgive.title: When Wife Won't Forgive

wrong.text: In the movie Wrong, based on the novel by Jana Aston, Sophie Tisdale has a foolproof plan to lose her virginity before senior year ends...until someone informs her that her partner-to-be has a bet on whether he can film taking her v-card. That someone being Luke, her gorgeous coffee shop regular....slash her new pelvic examiner. How wrong is it to have a thing for your campus gynecologist...and why doesn't Sophie really seem to care?
wrong.title: Wrong

wrong-marriage-fated-groom.text: Emily's fiance Henry breaks up with her on their wedding day. Pushed by her toxic best friend, Fiona, she agrees to enter a fake marriage with another man, but mistakes William, her mysterious billionaire CEO, for the man she's supposed to marry. After the wedding, William finds out that Emily is one of his employees, while Emily mistakenly believes that William is drowning in debt. William hides his identity till the day of the design competition when Fiona and Henry plot to sabotage Emily.
wrong-marriage-fated-groom.title: Wrong Marriage, Fated Groom

you-are-my-destiny.text: In You Are My Destiny movie, Logan was blind and abandoned—until Giselle saved him, and they fell in love. She sacrificed everything for him, even giving him her corneas. But just as he regained his sight, she was gone. What he didn’t know was that she was pregnant—and fate made her his wife. Five years later, Logan returns as the Hale heir, unaware that his wife and their ailing daughter are the very ones he’s been searching for. When the truth finally comes out, will he win them back—or has he already lost them forever?
you-are-my-destiny.title: You Are My Destiny

you-drive-me-crazy.text: In You Drive Me Crazy movie, 6 years ago, car restorer Yasmin was drugged and had a passionate encounter with a handsome homeless guy she thought she’d never see again — only to discover she was carrying his child. Now, fighting to save her 5-year-old son, she takes a job as secretary to Tristen Mars, former race car driver and CEO of Mars Motor Group. Little does she know this billionaire is the father of her little boy! As old sparks reignite and hidden truths come dangerously close to the surface, Yasmin and Tristen fall for each other while still unaware that they’re the very strangers they’ve spent years longing to find.
you-drive-me-crazy.title: You Drive Me Crazy

you-ve-got-male.text: A few minutes after getting married, Leila's husband was screwing another woman. She found out that his marriage to her was a plot to steal her wealth. Desperate for a husband and a child, Leila sleeps with an escort who turns out to be her admirer. Will Leila accept his love for her when he reveals his identity?
you-ve-got-male.title: You've Got Male
